name: Natal Chart Reading
purpose: Your whole chart, your whole story — who you are, the patterns you live, and what the sky is stirring right now.
method: Full natal chart interpretation with a classical lens: planets, signs, houses, aspects, and current transits to the natal chart.
bestFor: A first professional reading — the real thing, not an app summary
A crossroads in career, relationship, or identity that wants a wider lens
Knowing your 'big three' and suspecting there's much more in the chart (there is)
notFor: A single yes-or-no question — a horary reading answers that directly
Two people's compatibility — that's a relationship reading
format: In person in DFW, by inquiry
intakeRequirements: Exact birth time (birth certificate if possible)
Your main questions or areas of focus
includes: A guided tour of your Sun, Moon, rising, and full planetary picture
Dominant life themes: vocation signals, relationship patterns, underused gifts
What the current sky is activating in your chart right now
Space for your questions throughout — a conversation, not a lecture
deliverables: A copy of your natal chart
preparation: Confirm your birth time from a birth certificate if you can
Bring two or three real questions you're living with
Find a quiet spot and give yourself a few unhurried minutes afterward
cancellationPolicy: See the booking policy — to be confirmed by owner.
reschedulingPolicy: See the booking policy — to be confirmed by owner.
